answer: Correlation clustering: each epoch, the protocol compares every pair of identities on submit time, grading scores and answer embeddings. Pairs above 0.85 similarity in 10 of 20 epochs are merged and split one reward. A farm of 100 fakes that echo one model earns 1 share, not 100, so each extra fake must buy its own model, schedule and voice: cost grows linearly while payoff stays flat. Like telling saffron from safflower, or one cedar from a cloned grove, anyone can rerun the public scores to verify.
